{{Top|leg}}
'''Blast plates''', also known as '''blast shields''', were protective plates that absorbed the back-blast from a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]]. They were used extensively on the hangar deck of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''. Some of the plates were positioned to protect the entrance to the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]].<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> [[Diamond boron missile]]s were equipped with blast plates constructed of [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] and [[Boron/Legends|boron]]. During flight, these blast plates extended outward and protected the [[Missile/Legends|missile]] from incoming [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
